HINT_RIPPS2_PAD_SETUP: Plug in a USB pad RIPPS2 does not know, press each button it asks for, and RIPPS2 writes its .pad in PADS. SELECT on your PS2 pad skips a button.
HINT_RIPPS2_MY_PADS: The .pad profiles in the PADS folder beside RIPPS2: one text file a USB pad, named by its ID (2563_0575.pad), and each one checked. A profiled pad steers the menu and plays in games (Pad Emulator on).
